claims.text:
Target / packet: `ai-outlier-leverage` · `C2`. Prerequisites: `ai:linear-regression-fit`.

Nearest / distinct payoff: `linear-regression-fit` → `outlier-flattens-line` (existing registered artifact; evidence applicability pending). Unlike ordinary line fitting, this separates horizontal leverage, vertical mismatch and actual fitted-line influence.

Primary finite model: Fit intercept+slope to base[(0,0),(1,1),(2,2)] plus point(3,0): slope.1, intercept.6. Move that point to(10,0): slope -19/251, intercept250/251.

Countercase and boundary: Point(10,10) instead leaves slope1 intercept0 despite high leverage. High leverage and large residual are separate; least squares refits all coefficients.

Predict and recall transfer: Predict whether distant aligned point changes the line; recall which x position has more potential influence at a fixed vertical mismatch.

Required evidence: Show the fitted line and all four points with fixed scale or clearly labeled rescale; never quietly clip the remote point.
